VAL-CROSS-001.notes: MECHANISM DEVIATION (environment drift, within-boundary workaround): the contract precondition expects deleting the six acme organization-level rows to fall back to 'seeded system false rows'. In local D1 (what App dev reads) the system-level reservations.enabled row is TRUE (data.db has false), and getFeatureFlag resolves user -> organization -> system (packages/common/src/feature-flags.server.ts). Deleting the six org rows therefore did NOT hide the module for acme: navigations at 23:10:14Z and 23:11:12Z still redirected /acme/reservations -> /acme/reservations/today with 200 and issued a book-scope token (evidence: VAL-CROSS-001-delete-only-still-on.har/.png and VAL-CROSS-001-retest-after-delete.har). The off state for checkpoint 1 was therefore induced with the six acme ORGANIZATION rows set to false (an org override beats the system row; still exclusively acme rows), and then restored to true. Changing the D1 system row would affect every org (including riyadh-grill) and other validators, so it was left untouched. FLAG-OFF WINDOW (as requested): the module was actually hidden only from 2026-10-16 23:11:55Z to 23:12:37Z UTC (42 s); the earlier 23:10:08Z-23:11:55Z period had the org rows deleted but produced no user-visible change for any org. Follow-up for the mission owner: set D1's system reservations.enabled row to false to match the contract's assumption, or amend the contract to say 'set the six acme org rows to false' instead of delete. Other notes: (1) the sidebar nav cache (root loader, 30 s TTL) required waiting ~35 s before the group appeared/disappeared - confirmed. (2) agent-browser ref clicks on the Reservations sidebar group and submenu links are covered by an aside overlay / the Get-started card; in-page document.querySelector click() was used (known runtime finding). (3) The services create form defaults to Sun-Fri selected and the row edit flow cannot change days (name/times only), so a first create ended as Sat-only (daysMask 64); it was deleted (archived, srv_f823e4d5-1220-46e9-b331-168c65b81bc7) and recreated correctly (active srv_0e694cd5-32b7-40b2-8eb9-4950ad5f2b7a, mask 127). (4) The service UI has no effective_from/effective_to fields (weekday mask only), so the date-confinement isolation instruction could not be applied literally; the label G17- prefix was used. (5) HAR records the document server-redirect hop as status 0 with no headers; the redirect was proven with fetch redirect:'error' (throws) plus the followed final URL and the 404 contrast while off. (6) The cookie banner overlays the lower sidebar in screenshots; the accessibility snapshot (0 reservation matches) is the definitive sidebar-off evidence. Console errors: none throughout all flows.
